🚨📲 Instagram has rolled out a new feature called “Instants” that can now be found in your DMs! Think IG Stories, but more spontaneous 👀

The feature lets you share, unfiltered photos that disappear after 24 hours and are only visible to your friends. Want to try it out? Head to your DMs, tap the icon in the bottom-right corner of your screen, and start sharing 📸🔥 Tap into Front Page News 📰 w/ @mimibrowntv

In an interview, Nicki Minaj explained how she was always, deep down, a Trump supporter and how she feels the music industry influences people to become Democrats. She also speaks on losing trust in Obama and Gov. Newsom. Tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa

Kier Gaines breaks down why proper training matters in the world of therapy and explains how being a licensed clinician helps professionals provide real, solution-based guidance while following ethical standards and practices. 🧠🎙️Tap into the full conversation on @netflix

Tap in for the conversation on @netflix
